basics.name: Mikaeel Faraz
basics.label: Operations Strategy Analyst, qlub
basics.summary: Operations strategy at a Dubai fintech. I take problems from the analysis to the decision, and build the dashboards, automations and internal tools that make it stick.

work.name: qlub
work.summary: QR pay-at-table fintech. Operations strategy across account management, customer success and leadership in the UAE and Qatar.
highlights: Designed, built and run the internal operations platform (React, Netlify Functions, Supabase/Postgres, Google sign-in): dashboards, process guides, forms and scheduled data jobs used by operations, support and leadership.
Built self-service onboarding for a new merchant vertical in 30 days: secure client links with KYC and IBAN validation, a review step, and one-click setup across the internal systems.
Built scheduled ETL from Tableau and Zoho CRM into Postgres, reconciled to Tableau's own totals, and the SQL reports behind the team's performance reviews.
Built Zoho CRM automation (Deluge) that checks every live venue daily and creates, assigns and closes account-manager tasks when thresholds are crossed.
Replaced a spreadsheet relay with a signed, idempotent webhook from production alerts to Zoho Desk tickets; built helpdesk-Trello sync and WhatsApp and Slack alerting.
Built a difference-in-differences model to measure a staff incentive programme against a control group, and a monthly report on merchants' public ratings after go-live.
